==Russian==

===Etymology===
{{inh+|ru|sla-pro|*rodìti}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|роди́ть}}
* {{audio|ru|Ru-родить.ogg}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|роди́ть|both|impf=рожда́ть,рожа́ть|vn=рожде́ние}}

# to [[give birth]]
# to [[give rise to]]
# to [[bear]], to [[yield]] {{q|of [[land]]}}

====Usage notes====
* The usage of this verb in the imperfective is dated. Modern Russian allows only the use as a perfective.
* All forms are identical between the perfective and imperfective conjugation, with the exception of {{l|ru|родила́|tr=-}} (pf) / {{l|ru|роди́ла|tr=-}} (impf) and inevitable differences due to the aspect: the perfective has no present participles and uses the present forms of the imperfective for the future.

====Conjugation====
''perfective:''
{{ru-conj|pf|4b/c+pжд|роди́ть}}
{{ru-conj|pf|4b/c+pжд|роди́ть|old=1}}
''imperfective (dated):''
{{ru-conj|impf|4b+pжд|роди́ть}}
{{ru-conj|impf|4b+pжд|роди́ть|old=1}}
